name: boil_note_fresh
note: SKILL GUIDE - you must finish ALL steps or the task FAILS (a pot on the stove with the burner OFF still fails): 1) The pot filled with water is on a COUNTER, not the stove. Start with navigate_to('counter'). 2) obs=get_observation(); rgb=obs['robot0_robotview']['images']['rgb']; depth=...['depth']; K=...['intrinsics']; Tc=...['pose_mat'] (maps camera coords to base frame). 3) Find the pot: for p in ['pot','metal pot','saucepan','pot with water','kettle','vessel']: masks=segment_sam3_text_prompt(rgb,p); if masks: break. If none: (u,v)=point_prompt_molmo(rgb,'pot').get('pot',(None,None)); if u is not None: masks=segment_sam3_point_prompt(rgb,(u,v)). Take the highest-score mask m; seg=np.zeros(m.shape,dtype=int); seg[m]=1. 4) Grasp (retry up to 3x with different prompts if it fails): gp,gs=plan_grasp(depth,K,seg); if gp.shape[0]==0: re-observe and try another prompt/point. Else i=int(np.argmax(gs)); M=Tc@gp[i]; pos=M[:3,3]; R=M[:3,:3]; q=WXYZ quaternion from R. Then: open_gripper(); move_to_joints(solve_ik(pos+[0,0,0.10],q)); move_to_joints(solve_ik(pos,q)); close_gripper(); move_to_joints(solve_ik(pos+[0,0,0.16],q)). 5) navigate_to('stove') and RE-OBSERVE (the frame changed). Carry the held pot to the front/center burner: estimate the burner-top xy from the new obs, solve_ik to a point ~0.06m above it, move straight down until the pot rests on the burner, open_gripper(), lift 0.15m. 6) Turn the burner ON: find the stove knob/dial (segment 'knob'/'dial'/'stove knob', or point_prompt_molmo 'stove knob'), IK to it, and push/turn it clockwise with the gripper (approach from above, then move toward +x/+y to rotate); repeat 1-2x until it registers on. 7) Leave the gripper more than 0.15m from the pot. ROBUSTNESS (most trials die here - fix it): wrap each perception/IK block in try/except with a fallback prompt; ALWAYS re-observe after every navigate_to; if plan_grasp returns empty, retry with a different prompt or a point prompt before giving up; keep the program concise so it is not truncated; NEVER stop before step 6 is done.
